issues.issue: Utility spending printed by cost type must take the cost type as category with function 'utilities' (user rule 2026-10-28), as the statement-level disbursements in this same JSON already do (Salaries and Wages, Utilities and Telephone/utilities, Repairs and Maintenance, Professional/Contract Services, Supplies and Materials, Insurance, Fuel, Dues, Training and Travel, other, Depreciation). All 30 proprietary detail expense lines carry category 'utilities' and no function field. Fix: set each line's category to its cost type (matching disbursements[9..19]) and add function: utilities. Amounts are correct.
